evidence: Adds trigger_reorg() into test_framework/blocktools.py and consolidates reorg simulation logic across functional tests.
rationale: The PR consolidates duplicated reorg helper functions into test_framework/blocktools.py and improves test accuracy by replacing invalidateblock with fork-based reorgs across 13 test files. While it improves test code cleanliness and exercises real competing-chain code paths, it does not fix a flaky failure or critical missing test coverage.
